# Drawer

Surfaces that are anchored to the left, right or top edge of the screen. They are used to create Panels containing supplementary content.

It is used internally by the <LinkTo kind="Components/SideNav" story="temporary">Side Navigation</LinkTo> component.

<Source code="import { Drawer } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

### Focus

This example wraps content with a `<div tabIndex="-1"></div>` to avoid scrolling to the bottom buttons on opening.

See <LinkTo kind="Components/Modal" story="focus">Modal</LinkTo> documentation on how to manage focus.
